name: Rooted Lanyardloop
description: Raise the baton to the shoulder and tuck the elbow, holding a guard that can drop into a strike or a block.

name: Stunscorer
description: Snap the baton's tip straight into the soft point under the opponent's collarbone.

name: Truncheon Swerve
description: Slip a pace to the side as the opponent commits, leaving only the baton in their path.

name: Balanceknob Screen
description: Sweep the baton outward from the elbow to push a straight blow past the ear.

name: Binding Switch
description: Pass a pulse of qi down the arm into a rap on the nerve at the wrist, deadening the opponent's hand.

name: Gripping Cuff
description: After parrying, press the baton across the opponent's forearm with qi in the shaft and hold the arm pinned against the body.

name: Rigid Capend
description: Carry the truncheon low in a loose grip with the loop on the wrist, ready to rise and hook.

name: Rude Crackdown
description: Draw the truncheon from the belt loop in a single motion and cut across the opponent's hand.

name: Shielding Batongrip
description: Slide the truncheon down the forearm to meet a punch and carry it away from the face.

name: Springing Weightend
description: Shuffle in with the lead foot first and the rear foot trailing, shrinking the distance quietly.

name: Acrid Rapidrap
description: Hook the truncheon's end behind the opponent's calf and tug, buckling the knee.

name: Shortstick Carapace
description: Catch the truncheon in the opponent's collar and pull down, bringing the head forward.

name: Clutching Sidebar
description: Feed the truncheon under the opponent's armpit and hitch it over the wrist, locking the arm with a steady flow of qi.

name: Entangling Cuff
description: Turn the truncheon like a winding cord round a seized wrist, wrenching the grip loose with a qi-stiffened twist.

name: Shardbilly
description: Grip the rod a hand-width from one end with the other hand ready at the middle, so it can lever as well as guard.

name: Discord Crackdown
description: Press the rod's heel into the hollow of the opponent's shoulder, turning their swing to nothing.

name: Honed Hardwood
description: Jab the rod's tip into the gap between two ribs as the opponent breathes in.

name: Brawnswitch
description: Slip to the outside of the opponent's lead foot and pivot so that the back is protected.

name: Capend Prop
description: Cross the wrists in front of the face and use the rod's middle to catch a blow and turn it up.

name: Gripwrap Barrier
description: Lay the rod across the back of the opponent's wrist and bend the hand inward, qi in the lever holding the lock.

name: Regimen Tick
description: Set the rod under the elbow and drop the weight forward on a qi-stiffened lever, bearing the opponent down.

name: Batonbuckle
description: Hold the baton at chest height for a ten-count, relaxing the shoulders while the grip stays firm.

name: Acrid Hardwood
description: Cut the baton level through the opponent's hip with a turn of the waist.

name: Cruel Stun
description: Reverse the grip and hammer the baton's butt down onto the opponent's instep or hand.

name: Switch Zip
description: Drag the rear foot up behind the lead to close the gap without lifting the heels.

name: Rooted Weightend
description: Slap the baton to the inside of an incoming forearm, redirecting it across the opponent's own body.

name: Capendslap
description: Tap the baton twice on the same spot in quick succession, the second tap driven by the rebound.

name: Stunscreen
description: Tug the opponent's arm toward you, then reverse into a push as they pull back against you.

name: Tickbarrier
description: Loop the baton over the opponent's shoulder and draw it back, qi in the shaft steadying the held joint.

name: Rapidrap Buckle
description: Spiral the baton round the opponent's arm and tighten, so that qi-backed pressure keeps the limb from moving.

name: Tickhasp
description: Press the baton into the muscle at the base of the neck on the opponent's in-breath, with a qi pulse that stuns the shoulder.

name: Steady Truncheon
description: Hold the rod with the free hand open and forward, ready to seize a wrist as the rod guards the line.

name: Honedcuff
description: Spin the rod once in the fingers and let its tip land on the opponent's wrist.

name: Billyscreen
description: Check a thrust with the rod against the inner arm and slide it outward.

name: Claytick
description: Advance rolling heel to toe so that the rod never bobs on the way in.

name: Viselike Gripwrap
description: Hook the rod low behind the opponent's ankle and lift, unbalancing the stance.

name: Stern Tick
description: Rake the rod down the opponent's shin from knee to ankle, scraping the bone.

name: Levering Batongrip
description: Twist the seized wrist against the rod and hold the angle, a steady thread of qi keeping the lock tight.

name: Dusk Balanceknob
description: Slide the rod beneath the opponent's chin and lift sharply with a qi-stiffened arm, forcing the head back.

name: Sleet Truncheon
description: Reverse the lock into an arm bar across the elbow and hold it with the rod's weight and a pulse of qi.

name: Resolute Shortstick
description: Hold the cudgel upright against the shoulder, elbows tucked, so nothing swings wide in a tight passage.

name: Raw Weightend
description: Thrust the cudgel's butt straight ahead along the line of a corridor into the opponent's body.

name: Batonhurdle
description: Set the foot on the stair's edge and the toe against the riser so the balance holds on a slope.

name: Padded Gripwrap
description: Use the door frame as a second guard and bat an attack against it with the cudgel.

name: Billyflog
description: Cut the cudgel sideways under a low beam, never raising it above the shoulder.

name: Billyhasp
description: Press the cudgel across the opponent's chest and pin the body to the wall, qi in the forearms holding the pressure.

name: Binding Lanyardloop
description: Jam the cudgel's tip into a sleeve or pocket and twist with qi, tying up the arm for a heartbeat.

name: Brass Hardwood
description: Rest the baton along the forearm with the tip forward, so the guard can turn into a cut.

name: Claycuff
description: Draw the baton from the hip and rap the opponent's lead hand in one motion.

name: Rill Sidebar
description: Raise the baton with both hands to meet a downward blow, spreading the impact over two arms.

name: Scudding Capend
description: Chain two sidesteps in a row, the second angling toward the opponent's open flank.

name: Emberbilly
description: Drag the baton low across the ground and sweep it up into the opponent's ankle.

name: Brassstun
description: Close the fist round the baton's butt cap and punch through the opponent's guard.

name: Gagging Stun
description: Roll the baton over the opponent's elbow and trap it against the ribs, with qi in the shaft keeping the arm folded.

name: Lanyardloop Barrier
description: Hook the baton into the pit behind the opponent's knee and pull with a qi surge, dropping the leg.

name: Capendscreen
description: Hold the rod before the belly while walking, so the guard travels with the feet.

name: Draught Tick
description: Thrust the rod's tip into the opponent's midsection as the front foot lands.

name: Draught Batongrip
description: Slide the lead foot across the gap in one skimming motion, the rod hand leading.

name: Switchflog
description: Chop the rod down in an overhand arc onto the opponent's shoulder.

name: Haze Sidebar
description: Check the opponent's chest with the rod held crosswise, stopping a rush mid-stride.

name: Clay Stun
description: Drop into a crouch and step beneath a wide swing, the rod covering the head.

name: Sleet Balanceknob
description: Snare the opponent's wrist between rod and forearm as the gap closes, qi steadying the grip that holds it.

name: Rapidrap Hasp
description: Hook the rod behind the opponent's inside ankle and trip them with a qi-driven pull.

name: Dusk Cuff
description: With the wrist pinned under the rod, drag it down and hold it to the ground with a steady qi pressure.
